question.en: What kind of race do the children compete in?
question.zh: 孩子们参加的是什么比赛？

sentences.en: What kind of race do the children compete in?
sentences.zh: 孩子们参加的是什么比赛？

sentences.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
sentences.zh: 实验证明，儿童在很小的时候就可以接受游泳训练。

sentences.en: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶一个专门的游泳池里，

sentences.en: children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
sentences.zh: 孩子们甚至还不会走路，就已经能熟练地在水下屏住呼吸了。

sentences.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
sentences.zh: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不不愿意下水。

sentences.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就习惯了游泳，能从池底捡起重物。

sentences.en: A game that is very popular with these
young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
sentences.zh: 小游泳者很喜欢的一项游戏是水下三轮车比赛。

sentences.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
sentences.zh: 三轮车排放在水下七英尺深的池底。

sentences.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
sentences.zh: 孩子们互相比赛，看谁先到池子的另一端。

sentences.en: Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
sentences.zh: 许多孩子踩三轮车，但大多数宁愿推着或拉着它们走。

sentences.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
sentences.zh: 有些孩子能游完整个泳池的长度，一次也不浮上来换气。

sentences.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
sentences.zh: 他们将来能否成为奥林匹克冠军，只有时间能回答。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us
sentences.zh: 同时，他们应当鼓励我们当中

sentences.en: who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
sentences.zh: 那些游不到五码就气喘吁吁的人。
